A [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''bird''' was native to [[Biitu]],<ref name="Heep" /> an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Cassander sector/Legends|Cassander sector]].<ref name="Geo51">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> It had a plump body and a tapering tail, which was about the same length as its body. On each side of this body, it sported a wing, with which it was capable of flight. Each wing had four dominant feathers. The body, tail and wings of this avian species all had a uniform, [[Color/Legends|orange]] plumage. The [[Bird/Legends|birds]] had two short, yellow [[Limb/Legends|legs]], which stuck out anteriorly while in flight. They had a small head, with a triple-pointed crest, and a short, yellow beak. Their [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] had white scleras and black pupils. The species had a musical call.<ref name="Heep" />

==Behind the scenes==
This species of bird appeared briefly in ''[[The Great Heep]]'', a [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] television special written by [[Ben Burtt]]<ref name="Heep" /> and released on [[June 7]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 32">{{InsiderCite|32|Caravan of Courage: Star Wars on Television|''Caravan of Courage'': ''Star Wars'' on Television}}</ref>
